== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-magneticsuctiontube-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Magnetic Suction Tube]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Magnetic Suction Tube (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “Sandcrawler. During” becomes “sandcrawler. Once during each of”; “phase,” becomes “phases,”. These are the same words as [[Magnetic Suction Tube (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Magnetic Suction Tube” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
